summary: Block. TASK-028 fixes the literal map L(x)=1-x^564522 and the direct 64-coordinate, 65-equation arity-16 System (4), but its repository recovery completion is only a one-way sound acceptance filter: direct-System-(4) recovery completeness, missed components, multiplicities, and the recovery distribution remain unproved. Pointwise equivalence with a quadratic circuit does not establish equality of ideals, saturation, multiplicities, solving degree, fill-in, memory, or runtime, and the frozen recursive projective presentation likewise supplies no direct-system solver-cost equivalence; transferring a solver advantage among these presentations would therefore be a semantic reencoding. The only source-grounded cost expression, P(p,16)+(16!*p/D^15)T(E,16,L)+D^omega, leaves T open and does not bound complete recovery, independent-relation yield and rank, sparse linear algebra, preprocessing, storage, or a common-unit equal-success comparison, so no complete B(p)=o(p^(1/2)) causal bridge exists. TASK-027's exact 283527 liftable x values and 94509 liftable GLV x-orbits are structural census facts, not usable factor-log columns, a relation-yield law, rank evidence, or solver evidence; its at-most-24-bit regime is explicitly inapplicable to M16 exponent inference, so those proxies cannot decide the slope claim. Finally, the proposal and mechanism design declare the seven-field mechanism identity unchanged from HGP-M16-SOLVER-SLOPE-001, novelty false, and no new cost-changing premise. The package is therefore a duplicate or reencoding rather than a cryptanalytically testable successor, and zero compute and zero retention are the supported disposition.
